message:
Choosing a Wedding Venue? Filter by These 3 Things First

Before you fall in love with a space, filter by the things you can't bend: your budget, your guest count and your date range. A stunning venue that seats 80 doesn't work for 150 guests, no matter how good the photos look.

Then, on every tour, picture the actual flow: where guests park, where the ceremony becomes the reception, and what happens if it rains.

Read the full guide: https://bridalteam.com/guides/how-to-choose-a-wedding-venue?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-11&utm_content=2026-11-25-noon-filter-wedding-venues
